op20_disclosures: 1. DAILY HISTORY: yfinance period='max' returned 4,320 daily bars, 2014-09-17 .. 2026-07-16 (~11.85 years) — spans the 2017 bull, 2018 bear, 2020 COVID crash, 2021 bull, 2022 bear, and 2024-26 regimes, vs Pass 1's 730-bar/2-year window.

2. PARAMS CHANGED FOR DAILY GRANULARITY: see job1_daily_history.setup_params_daily and run_pass2.py's DAILY_SETUP_PARAMS docstring for the reasoning behind each adjustment (not a mechanical bar-count conversion).

3. SWEEP DISCIPLINE: per-combo chronological IS/OOS split (train=first 65% of the date range), Benjamini-Hochberg FDR correction ACROSS the full 108-combo grid (family-wise, not per-combo alpha), random-entry null (>=200 independent single-trade draws, same exit shape, entries restricted to the OOS window), yearly sub-window stability (majority of years-with-trades net positive), and — only for combos that already clear all of the above — a cross-check against Pass 1's original, untouched 4h/2-year window.

4. NO LOOK-AHEAD (C6): signals computed from bars[0:i+1] only; entries fill at the NEXT bar's open. Null-trade entries are real historical bars drawn from the OOS window only (never before the IS/OOS cutoff).
5. SIZING: fixed notional per trade (risk_pct_per_trade of a nominal $2,000, non-compounding) — same convention as Pass 1, not a live equity curve.
6. BACKTEST ONLY: no order was placed, no broker was called, no account was touched.
